tiers.label: Purchase Tiers
tiers.title: How Balance Clearing Works
tiers.desc: Each purchase is a donation that simultaneously zeroes your Apple ID balance. Buy the tier that matches your balance — Apple charges it from credit first, then card.

items.name: Tier 1
items.desc: Equal to 1 credit coin. Clears a balance of ~$0.99.

items.name: Tier 2
items.desc: 2 credit coins. Clears a balance of ~$1.99.

items.name: Tier 3
items.desc: 3 credit coins. Use when your balance is around $2–3.

items.name: Tier 4
items.desc: 4 credit coins. Best for clearing a $3–4 leftover.

items.name: Tier 10
items.desc: 10 credit coins. Clears larger balances around $9–10.

tiers.note: Smart Balance Matcher automatically selects the optimal combination of tiers to reach exactly $0.00.
